title: From the Vault: Annihilation: card flavor text

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane once split into five shards.

entities.name: Child of Alara
entities.description: A being born of the Maelstrom that shows no allegiance or mercy to any of the five shards.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: The phenomenon whose progeny is the Child of Alara.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard whose nations stood united against a common threat.

entities.name: Horse clans
entities.description: Clans whose wisdom advises keeping only mount, blade, and wits.

entities.name: Elvish dawnhands
entities.description: Elves who test relics' worthiness before collecting them for the safehold.

entities.name: Olantin
entities.description: A lost coastal polis of legend whose inhabitants' hubris enraged Heliod.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god, enraged by the hubris of Olantin's inhabitants.

events.summary: The nations of Bant forget their war and unite against a common threat.
events.quote: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

events.summary: In legend, the hubris of Olantin's inhabitants enrages the sun god Heliod and the polis is lost.
events.quote: Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.

relations.quote: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.
whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.
